entities.name: Zhu of Xia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zhu was the seventh king of the semi-legendary Xia dynasty of Ancient China. Along with the reign of his father Shao Kang, Zhu's rule was considered a peaceful and prosperous period of the Xia's history.
